exact_target: Prove on the existing regular space: regularSpectralResolvent P belongs to regularCoreAlgebra P; every B in its commutant preserves the graph of the already constructed positive generator. Reuse local pairings from character commutation, conjugation by V=W F^-1 and the double commutant. No simple-function approximation machinery, new affiliated-form object or replacement generator. This is the commutant criterion of affiliation of the closed operator; dual scaling and trace remain separate.

providers.name: character_commutation_local_pairing
providers.statement:
theorem character_commutation_local_pairing
    (B : RegularHilbert H →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert H)
    (hB : ∀ s : ℝ, characterMultiplier s * B = B * characterMultiplier s)
    (f g : RegularHilbert H) :
    (fun x : ℝ => inner ℂ ((B.adjoint f) x) (g x)) =ᵐ[volume]
      (fun x : ℝ => inner ℂ (f x) ((B g) x))

providers.name: realScalarMultiplier_ae
providers.statement:
theorem realScalarMultiplier_ae (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : Continuous g)
    (h0 : ∀ s, 0 ≤ g s) (h1 : ∀ s, g s ≤ 1) (f : RegularHilbert H) :
    realScalarMultiplier g hg h0 h1 f =ᵐ[volume] fun s => (g s : ℂ) • f s

providers.name: regularSpectralCoordinates_character
providers.statement:
theorem regularSpectralCoordinates_character (P : SiteProfile) (t : ℝ)
    (u : RegularHilbert (TowerHilbert P)) :
    regularSpectralCoordinates P (characterMultiplier (2*Real.pi*t) u) =
      regularUnitary P t (regularSpectralCoordinates P u)

providers.name: regularSpectralResolvent
providers.statement:
def regularSpectralResolvent (P : SiteProfile) :
    RegularHilbert (TowerHilbert P) →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert (TowerHilbert P)

providers.name: resolvent_graph_equation
providers.statement:
theorem resolvent_graph_equation (R : H →L[ℂ] H) (hi : Function.Injective R) (x y : H) :
    (x,y) ∈ (resolventGraphOperator R hi).graph ↔ (1-R) x = R y

providers.name: regularUnitary_mem
providers.statement:
theorem regularUnitary_mem (P : SiteProfile) (t : ℝ) :
    regularUnitary P t ∈ regularCoreAlgebra P

providers.name: mem_commutant_iff
providers.statement:
theorem mem_commutant_iff {S : VonNeumannAlgebra H} {z : H →L[ℂ] H} :
    z ∈ S.commutant ↔ ∀ g ∈ S, g * z = z * g

providers.name: commutant_commutant
providers.statement: theorem commutant_commutant (S : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : S.commutant.commutant = S
